author: Henry Zweiman

visual_review.outcome: All 44 pages rendered and inspected in eleven contact sheets. A final heading-placement edit changed only pages 42 and 43; all other page PNG hashes were unchanged. The changed pages and pages 40 and 41 were inspected individually at full rendering size. No clipping, overlap, missing glyphs or orphaned new heading remains. The conserved quantity, reconstruction, concavity, convexity, strict count comparison and endpoint corollary are legible.

proof_status: Artifact integrity only; not independent mathematical certification
